accuracy: Mapped layout and source or estimated heights. Facades, tree planting, landmark details and distant ground elevation are approximate.
rendering: Architectural city atlas with a restrained material palette, a procedural cloud sky and sun, cached environment lighting and sun shadows, simulated weather, and reflective lake water with wind waves and rain ripples. Building geometry and the mapped shoreline are retained; weather, water color and lighting are illustrative.
